prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Please sign in with your original account method to keep your saved pets and progress."]
1: ["Preview Your Desktop Pet", "Watch how your new companion will walk and play across your desktop screen."]
2: ["Controls Guide: Right-click your pet anytime to talk, hide, or access settings."]
3: ["Summoning Your Desktop Pet", "Your pet is initializing and preparing to land on your screen."]
4: ["Upload Pet Photos", "Select photos of your pet so we can accurately generate their desktop avatar."]
5: ["Bring an Interactive Companion to Your Desktop", "Your pet lives directly on your computer screen, walking alongside your daily windows and apps."]
6: ["Sign In to Save Your Pet Profile", "Connect your account to save your companion's memory and settings across devices."]
7: ["Adoption Certificate Summary", "Review companion preferences before official desktop deployment."]
8: ["Desktop Pet Shortcuts", "Drag to move • Right-click for options • Click to chat. You're all set!", "Start Playing"]
9: ["You will receive a notification when your desktop pet is ready to launch."]
